title: Beef Tacos
teaser: Mince and a simple spice mix, spooned into tortillas with your favourite toppings.

ingredients.item: Lettuce, cheese, and salsa to serve

steps: Fry the onion in a little oil for 3-4 minutes until soft.
Add the beef mince and spices and cook, breaking it up, until browned through.
Warm the tortillas or taco shells.
Fill with the mince and top with lettuce, cheese, and salsa.

title: Bean & Cheese Quesadillas
teaser: A crisp, cheesy vegetarian option that's ready in one pan.

ingredients.item: black beans or kidney beans, drained and mashed lightly
Salsa and soured cream to serve

steps: Mix the mashed beans with the cumin.
Spread the bean mixture and cheese over half of each tortilla, then fold over.
Dry-fry each quesadilla in a pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa and soured cream.

title: Simple Chilli Con Carne
teaser: A weeknight-sized batch of chilli that also reheats well the next day.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4 minutes.
Add the beef mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the chilli powder and cumin, then add the tomatoes and kidney beans.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Serve over rice.

title: Beef Mince Nachos
teaser: A tray of nachos loaded with spiced mince and melted cheese, ready to share.

ingredients.item: Salsa and soured cream to serve

steps: Fry the mince with the cumin and paprika until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C) or use the grill.
Spread the tortilla chips on a baking tray and scatter over the mince.
Top with the grated cheddar and jalapeños if using.
Bake or grill for 5-8 minutes until the cheese has melted. Serve with salsa and soured cream.

title: Blackened Salmon Tacos
teaser: Spiced salmon and a quick lime slaw, piled into warm tortillas.
steps: Rub the salmon with the blackening seasoning.
Heat the oil in a pan and pan-fry the salmon for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and blackened at the edges. Flake into chunks.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and soured cream to make a quick slaw.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the salmon and slaw and serve.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
teaser: Shredded chicken rolled in tortillas, smothered in a smoky tomato sauce, and baked with cheese.

ingredients.item: cooked chicken, shredded (or 2 chicken breasts, cooked and shredded)

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4 minutes, then add the tomatoes and chipotle paste or paprika. Simmer for 8-10 minutes to make the sauce.
Mix a few spoonfuls of the sauce through the shredded chicken.
Divide the chicken between the tortillas, roll up, and place in an ovenproof dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top, scatter with cheese, and bake for 15-20 minutes until bubbling.

title: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Tacos
teaser: Roasted sweet potato and black beans spiced and piled into tortillas — a hearty vegetarian taco night.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the sweet potato with a little oil, cumin, and smoked paprika, then roast for 20-25 minutes until tender, stirring halfway.
Warm the black beans in a small pan for a few minutes.
Mix the lime juice through the soured cream.
Warm the tortillas, then fill with the sweet potato and black beans.
Drizzle with the lime crema and scatter with coriander.

title: Shrimp Tacos with Mango Salsa
teaser: Quick-fried shrimp with a fresh mango salsa — light, bright, and ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Toss the shrimp with the chilli powder and cumin.
Mix the mango, red onion, and half the lime juice together to make the salsa.
Heat a little oil in a pan and cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the shrimp and top with the mango salsa and remaining lime juice.

title: Turkey & Black Bean Quesadillas
teaser: A lighter take on quesadillas using turkey mince and black beans, ready in 15 minutes.

ingredients.item: Salsa and soured cream to serve

steps: Fry the turkey mince with the cumin and smoked paprika until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Stir in the black beans, warm through, and lightly mash some of the beans with the back of a spoon.
Spread the turkey and bean mixture and the cheese over half of each tortilla, then fold over.
Dry-fry each quesadilla in a pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa and soured cream.

title: Chorizo & Black Bean Tacos
teaser: Smoky chorizo and black beans piled into warm tortillas — a five-ingredient taco night.
steps: Fry the chorizo in a dry pan for 4-5 minutes until it releases its oil and starts to crisp.
Add the black beans and warm through for 2-3 minutes, lightly mashing some with the back of a spoon.
Stir in half the lime juice.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the chorizo and beans.
Top with red onion, coriander, and a squeeze of the remaining lime juice.

title: Chicken & Pepper Quesadillas
teaser: Spiced chicken and peppers folded into crisp, cheesy tortillas — ready in 20 minutes.

ingredients.item: Salsa and soured cream to serve

steps: Heat a little oil in a pan and fry the chicken with the cumin and smoked paprika for 6-7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the pepper and cook for a further 2-3 minutes until just softened. Remove from the heat.
Spread the chicken and pepper mixture and the cheese over half of each tortilla, then fold over.
Dry-fry each quesadilla in a pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa and soured cream.

title: Chicken Tinga Tacos
teaser: Smoky, shredded chicken simmered in a chipotle tomato sauce until it falls apart — a slower-tasting taco for barely any extra effort.
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, chipotle paste, and smoked paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast, chopped tomatoes, and stock, and simmer for 15-18 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken, shred with two forks, then return to the sauce and simmer for a further 5 minutes to thicken.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the shredded chicken tinga.

title: Chipotle Chicken Tacos with Lime Crema
teaser: Smoky chipotle chicken, pan-seared and piled into warm tortillas with a cooling lime crema.
steps: Toss the sliced chicken with the chipotle paste, olive oil, and a pinch of salt.
Heat a pan over high heat and cook the chicken for 6-8 minutes until charred and cooked through.
Mix the sour cream with half the lime juice and a pinch of salt to make the crema.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken, red onion, and coriander, then drizzle with the lime crema and remaining lime juice.

title: Steak Fajita Tacos with Charred Peppers
teaser: Seared steak strips and charred peppers folded into warm tortillas with a squeeze of lime.
steps: Toss the steak strips with the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over high heat and sear the steak for 2-3 minutes until browned. Remove and set aside.
Add the peppers to the same pan and cook for 5-6 minutes until charred and softened.
Return the steak to the pan, squeeze over the lime juice, and toss together.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the steak and peppers.
